GenAiPlugin.description: Handles requests where additional information is required and a case needs to be created.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user requests additional information, purchasing questions, or contract questions, initiate the process to create a case and gather the information needed to create that case.
Ask clarifying questions to gather all necessary details for the case.
Ensure the user provides sufficient information to proceed with case creation.
Confirm with the user before finalizing the case creation.
Only use this action if you were not able to provide the information that the user was requesting.
If a user asks how they can renew, purchase qss, request a quote, or determine which qss they need please gather information necessary to create a case.

GenAiPlugin.scope: I can create a case for the user when additional information is requested, ensuring all necessary details are gathered before proceeding.
